EasyInstall.Name: Vestigia - Rain Sheets (Optional)
EasyInstall.Author: no12 / merge
EasyInstall.Metadata: Optional add-on for VESTIGIA: turns on the wind-blown rain sheet / gust effect in Thunderstorm (same as the vanilla game). Must load AFTER Vestigia (below it in LML load order). Remove or disable this folder to turn sheets off.
